quotes.text: If you're putting a plan together and continuously collaborating with the team, and tracking that plan, you're going to be much more successful than if you just show up and say what do you guys want to do today.
Being a superintendent is a lot harder than what people think. Spend as much time as you can in the field interacting with your trades, because you'll learn a lot more there in a much quicker time.
It's fun. It's a grind, but it's fun, and you might not feel like it. There are some pretty stressful times, some sleepless nights, and it comes in phases.
